5. Conclusion 
Overpopulation is a multifaceted issue rooted in medical, cultural, and 
socioeconomic developments. Its consequences—ranging from 
environmental degradation to economic stress—highlight the need for 
coordinated global action. Effective solutions require a combination of 
education, empowerment, and sustainable policy interventions. Only 
through collective effort can societies manage population growth while 
ensuring a stable and equitable future.
